packages.name: dsh-plugin-pdd-ego
packages.note: NovaFlow 内维护的插件：ego 版拼多多多店铺上架（技能 pdd-ego-listing + pdd_ego_* 工具）。无第三方上游仓库；Python（需 openpyxl）默认使用 DSH 自带运行时，用户无需另装。

packages.name: dsh-plugin-taobao-ego
packages.note: NovaFlow 内维护的插件：ego 版淘宝/千牛商品上架（技能 taobao-ego-listing + tb_ego_* 工具）。只填空与自检、绝不提交；需要本机 ego 浏览器、带 openpyxl 的 Python（默认用 DSH 自带）与已登录的淘宝/千牛账号。

localChanges: dsh-douyin-comments 0.9.50：AI 解读 / LLM 情感复核改为只在订阅激活后可用（后端 402 + 购买引导），词云与本地统计不受影响；本地情感小模型（weibo-BERT int8）与 LLM 复核分层、缓存按文本 sha1 存本地；规则先跑、模型只校正中性、阈值 0.45。
Preserve upstream README as UPSTREAM-README.txt for third-party attribution.
Use a white comment-viewer palette and iframe.
dsh-skill-explorer is a Prokint-maintained fork: renamed, rebuilt as a standalone package, and stripped of anonymous install telemetry.
dsh-comment-viewer 0.2.16 is retained only as a compatibility package for profiles created before the merge; new profiles do not enable it.

dsh-skill-explorer 0.1.4 renders the skill list as a card grid and opens create/import/edit as dialogs from the list toolbar instead of nav tabs; a skill without a writable SKILL.md path (plugin-provided or fileless) shows no enable switch and no long explanation, because the switch could only change this panel’s view.
